title: Laredo Wears Pink Raises $55,685 for Breast Cancer Research and Services
excerpt: Laredo Wears Pink raised $55,685 for breast cancer research, programs and services, with its ambassadors honored at a gala after 15 nominees spent October raising money for the American Cancer Society's Laredo chapter.
content:
Laredo Wears Pink raised $55,685 for breast cancer research, programs and services, with the campaign's ambassadors honored at a gala, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The money came through the American Cancer Society's Pink Pearls & Heels and Men Wear Pink campaigns. Fifteen nominees raised more than $55,000 during October to fight breast cancer and other cancers, KGNS reported.

Jose Espinoza was the top fundraiser among the men, and Dorannette Morin led the women, according to KGNS. Proceeds went to the Laredo chapter of the American Cancer Society.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 24, 2026; KGNS, Nov. 17, 2026.
